t: You're at Electrowerkz, a late nineteenth-century industrial warehouse that was once a steel works factory. It has been a night club and event space since 1987. This is the home of Slimelight, the weekly goth night, alongside other nights like Torture Garden and Riot. Mayuan Mak, who lived from 1965 to 2020, is the entrepreneur and club owner who founded it. The building can also be hired for corporate events, brand launches, filming and photographic shoots.
